title: SDLC Work-Item ID v1
description: The repository-unique identifier of a work item. The prefix is one through ten uppercase ASCII letters, the separator is a hyphen, and the numeric portion may contain any number of digits. Leading zeroes are significant.
$comment: WorkItemId has the form {prefix}-{number}. Examples include WI-0003, GH-0042, and PROJECT-17. A work-item ID does not include a descriptive suffix; descriptive metadata belongs in the work-item record.
